decision_rule: Do not inherit the historical Emotion Engine deferral as automatic Emotion Governance ownership. The four capabilities are cross-owner semantic synthesis concerns and remain deferred.

decisions.execution_owner: Future separately authorized semantic synthesis runtime
decisions.source_owner: Typed candidates from relevant semantic owners, including Emotion Governance where affective evidence exists
decisions.persistence_owner: None in this phase; destination owner decides after synthesis contract
decisions.why: Generic semantic compression crosses owner boundaries and must not become hidden Emotion authority.

decisions.semantic_owner: Future Cross-Owner Semantic Synthesis Governance with Cognitive Memory & Experience Governance admission
decisions.source_owner: Emotion Governance affective candidates plus Cognitive Memory & Experience historical references
decisions.persistence_owner: Cognitive Memory & Experience Governance, only after a future persistence contract
decisions.why: Affective content originates from Emotion but compression changes memory semantics; neither owner may silently absorb the other.

decisions.source_owner: Emotion Governance and Cognitive Memory & Experience Governance
decisions.persistence_owner: Cognitive Memory & Experience Governance, if a future memory candidate is admitted
decisions.why: A summary is a cross-owner artifact, not an Emotion State and not an automatic Memory write.

decisions.source_owner: Personality Governance FROZEN_V1 and Cognitive Memory & Experience Governance, with Emotion references only when typed
decisions.persistence_owner: None in this phase; Personality remains non-persistent candidate-only
decisions.why: Personality is frozen and Memory owns historical semantics; Emotion Governance cannot fuse or mutate either owner.
